name: Wojak and feels
summary: A bald, line-drawn face in grey and cream with an exact emotion, set in a flat panel with a caption. It started on imageboards around 2010 and now stands for many roles. This entry covers its neutral drawing form only.

philosophy.core_thesis: Reduce a mood to one drawn face and a short label, so that a reader sees the feeling at once.
design_principles: Draw the face as a bald outline of 2px black on a flat cream (#F5E6D3) fill, with 5 to 8 facial lines.
Show one emotion in each panel through the brows, the mouth and a few tear or sweat marks.
Put the figure on a flat single-colour field, with the head at 40% to 60% of the height.
Add a label of 1 to 4 words in a plain sans-serif at 20px to 28px, in white or black.
Arrange comparison panels in 2 columns with a thin 2px divider.
Keep the lines slightly uneven, as hand-drawn by mouse.
Use grey and muted tints for the background; reserve one colour for emphasis.

layout.grid_mechanics: A single square panel of 600px x 600px, or two panels side by side with a 2px divider.
layout.whitespace_ratio: The figure takes 50% of the panel; the field and label take the rest.
layout.alignment_rules: Centred figure; the label sits under the figure at 8% from the bottom.
layout.container_geometry: Rectangular panels with a 0px radius; a flat field with no border.

font_pairings.note: A plain neutral sans that stays out of the way of the face.
A slightly wider sans for labels.

hierarchy_rules: Use medium weight (500) for the label.
Use white text on dark fields and black text on light fields.

color.palette_structure: A cream face and black line on one muted field; a second tint for the comparison panel.
color.contrast_rules: White label on field grey gives 8.6:1; black line on cream gives 16:1.
color.surface_treatment: Flat fills with no gradient; a faint 3% grain is allowed.

materiality.surface_simulation: A flat digital drawing from a paint program.
materiality.border_rules: A 2px black outline round the figure; no panel border.

ornamentation_details.iconography: No icons; tears and sweat marks serve as signs.
ornamentation_details.illustration: A bald head, a hooded or suited body; flat colour; no shading.

motion.transition_physics: Static image. A short loop may swap two faces each 500ms.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover swaps the face for the next mood.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels a clear, often sad or wry, mood and a sense of being understood.

avoid_when: The audience may read the face as a hate sign; use only neutral mood versions.
The brand needs a polished voice.

modifiers.how: Draw the face as a round rage face with thick lines and add 2 to 4 panels.
Reduce the drawing to a 1px outline on white with one label.
Place the figure in an odd scene with a strange crop and a calm caption.

pack.why: A plain hand-feel outline family that keeps the flat drawn tone.

ground.why: A soft flat field keeps one muted colour behind the figure.
